_nota: Autorado, no traducido (D-022). KINDER nunca lleva cifra (mc-20: el niño no lee). Ninguna cadena insinúa que el tiempo jugado dañó algo — mc-26 §7, Orben & Przybylski: como máximo 0.4% de la varianza de bienestar.
limite.aviso.kinder: One more, and then it's time to rest!
limite.aviso.lector: Five more minutes, and then we stop for today.
limite.descanso.cuerpo: Stand up, look out the window at something far away, and have some water.
limite.descanso.afuera: Even better: step outside for a moment.
limite.despedida.kinder: That's all for today. Larry will be here tomorrow!
limite.despedida.lector: Good work today. See you tomorrow.
limite.nocturno.kinder: The savanna is going to sleep. Good night!
limite.nocturno.lector: It's almost bedtime. Good night — see you tomorrow.
